name: real-12-how-tarsee-reads-each-failure
what: Each failure the captures recorded, and what the Node version's classifier (providers/codex-events.js classifyCodexFailure) makes of its words: the kind, whether the turn layer retries with a fresh thread (recoverable), and the words shown.

cases.what: resume of a thread id that has no rollout
cases.words:
Codex Exec exited with code 1: Reading prompt from stdin...
Error: thread/resume: thread/resume failed: no rollout found for thread id 01a1c000-0000-7000-8000-00000000dead (code -32600)

tarsee.message: **The earlier conversation couldn't be picked up again**, so I'm starting a fresh one.

cases.what: custom provider, env_key variable not set
cases.words: Missing environment variable: `TARSEE_PROVIDER_KEY`.

tarsee.message: **OpenRouter ran into a problem:** Missing environment variable: `TARSEE_PROVIDER_KEY`.

cases.what: unknown model (404), on openrouter
cases.words: The model `no-such-model` does not exist or you do not have access to it.

cases.what: refused key (401), on chatgpt
cases.words: unexpected status 401 Unauthorized: Incorrect API key provided: sk-test***, url: http://127.0.0.1:<MODEL_PORT>/v1/responses

tarsee.message:
**The ChatGPT sign-in has expired**, so I can't reach the model right now. Retrying won't fix it.

Sign in again in Settings > AI (it shows a link and a one-time code), or run `codex login --device-auth` in the Terminal. Then send your message again.
